## RambiBox 1.2.2

A small maintenance update after two weeks of real-world use (no crashes, no lost connections).

### Security
- Built with **.NET 10.0.14**, which includes Microsoft's latest security fixes. RambiBox carries its own copy of .NET, so these only reach you through a new version. The version is now shown under **Settings › About & updates** and in the log.

### Updates
- **The update question now reaches people who only use the tray.** It used to appear only on the Home page, so someone who never opens the window was never asked and never heard about new versions. RambiBox now asks once with a tray notification. Nothing changes until you answer: no automatic checks without your yes, and automatic installs stay off unless you turn them on.

### Smoother under heavy GPU load
- When a game or video saturates the graphics card, a screen capture no longer waits longer than 250 ms for it. RambiBox keeps the last colors, adds no extra work for the GPU and uses the frame as soon as it is ready, instead of holding up the light engine and busy-waiting in the graphics driver.

### For people upgrading from 1.1.0 or older
These versions have no updater: download `RambiBox.exe` below once. After that, updates are one click.
